en.shortDescription: Popular CMS for websites and blogs
en.longDescription:
WordPress powers millions of websites as a flexible content management system.

Includes MariaDB for persistent storage. Database credentials use SERVICE_USER_WORDPRESS and SERVICE_PASSWORD_WORDPRESS. Complete the web installer on first launch.

de.shortDescription: Beliebtes CMS für Websites und Blogs
de.longDescription:
WordPress betreibt Millionen von Websites als flexibles Content-Management-System.

Enthält MariaDB für persistenten Speicher. Datenbank-Zugangsdaten verwenden SERVICE_USER_WORDPRESS und SERVICE_PASSWORD_WORDPRESS. Schließe den Web-Installer beim ersten Start ab.

fr.shortDescription: CMS populaire pour sites web et blogs
fr.longDescription:
WordPress alimente des millions de sites web en tant que système de gestion de contenu flexible.

Inclut MariaDB pour le stockage persistant. Les identifiants de base de données utilisent SERVICE_USER_WORDPRESS et SERVICE_PASSWORD_WORDPRESS. Terminez l'installateur web au premier lancement.

pt.shortDescription: CMS popular para sites e blogs
pt.longDescription:
O WordPress alimenta milhões de sites como um sistema de gerenciamento de conteúdo flexível.

Inclui MariaDB para armazenamento persistente. As credenciais do banco usam SERVICE_USER_WORDPRESS e SERVICE_PASSWORD_WORDPRESS. Conclua o instalador web no primeiro acesso.
